data.spec: Source apps/server/src/procurement/plan.ts and apps/server/src/integrations/supplier.ts. planPurchase(station:Station,itemId:string|null,quantity:number,requests:OfficeRequest[]) → {kind:'duplicate',request:OfficeRequest}|{kind:'clarification',question:string}|{kind:'proposal',proposal:Proposal}. Proposal={kind:'purchase',product:Product,quantity,total_nok,currency:'NOK',simulation:true}; Product snapshot includes id,name,station_id,price_nok,delivery_estimate,supplier. Current Supplier.placeOrder(proposal:Proposal,idempotencyKey:string) is synchronous and returns {reference:string,simulation:true}; mock returns SIM-<key>. Async/real suppliers require coordinated contract changes and uncertain-state recovery, not a silent substitution.
